Attached: 1 image

There’s no practical way to develop Common #lisp on a 386 without using the REPL. You can’t quit out and edit the text file, then wait 15 minutes for everything to load again. You need to use the debugger to patch in small pieces of code, and incrementally compile everything. It’s the original old-school workflow, not the way we typically develop today. #vintagetech #programming
